title: Billing Desk Worksheet: Expedite Fee and Expedited Target Date (Factory Production Orders)
content:
For Factory Production Orders in a build class where an expedited build is available, the expedite fee and the expedited target ship date are fixed as follows.

**Per-unit charge.** The per-unit charge is the class expedite fee per unit times the units on the order.

**Expedite fee.** The expedite fee is the per-unit charge, raised to the class minimum expedite fee when it falls below it, booked on the request date and rounded to the cent, once, at the end.

**Expedited target ship date.** The expedited target ship date is the request date plus the class expedite lead time in business days, counted starting the day after the request date, Monday through Friday excluding U.S. federal holidays.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| units on the order | the factory order record |
| class expedite fee per unit, class minimum expedite fee, class expedite lead time | the order's build class |
| request date | the date the request is placed |

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders)

| Class | Units | Per-unit charge | Compared with the class minimum | Expedite fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build (45.00 per unit, minimum 195.00) | 3 | 135.00 | below 195.00 | 195.00 |
| Custom Size Build | 6 | 270.00 | above | 270.00 |
| Custom Color Build (55.00 per unit, minimum 225.00) | 4 | 220.00 | below 225.00 | 225.00 |
| Custom Color Build | 9 | 495.00 | above | 495.00 |

Target date example (no federal holiday in the period): a Custom Color Build request on a Monday, with an expedite lead time of 20 business days, has its expedited target ship date on the Monday four weeks later.

## Points of reading

- The minimum applies per order, after the per-unit charge is formed.
- The fee is dated the request date, whatever the order's later ship date turns out to be.
